case_number: 2025 INSC 121; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 1180-1181 OF 2025 (arising out of S.L.P. (Civil) Nos. 5785-5786 of 2023); CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 1182-1183 OF 2025 (arising out of S.L.P. (Civil) Nos. 6724-6725 of 2023)

parties.respondent: A. Prabhakar & ORS.; Beena Anthony & ORS.

summary: Condonation of delay in appeal by subsequent purchasers; lis pendens applicability under Section 52 of Transfer of Property Act; rejection of impleadment application for violating injunction; bona fides of post-injunction purchasers; no entitlement to appellate relief after finality of impleadment rejection; inordinate delay of 586 days unjustified.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court's condonation order set aside; dismissal of RFA No. 1303/2018 restored.
